content:
Last weekend, Apple TV made several announcements at San Diego Comic-Con, including a surprise reveal of the premiere date for Silo season 4.

Silo season 4 will debut in summer 2027 and will be the show's final season.

Silo season 3 is currently airing (available here), with new episodes released weekly until September 4.

However, at last weekend's San Diego Comic-Con, Apple not only shared updates on other sci-fi series but also delivered surprise news for fans of Silo.

Silo season 4 will premiere next summer and bring the entire series to a close.

Below is the announcement post Apple TV shared on platform X:

In the streaming era, it's common for new seasons of series to be released years apart, and this is especially true for high-budget sci-fi productions like Silo.

Nevertheless, Apple has been actively accelerating the return of some of its series through measures such as advance greenlights. In the case of Silo, seasons 3 and 4 were prepared and filmed back-to-back.

Silo still has six more weeks of new episodes to air, but after this season wraps up, viewers won't have to wait long for season 4.

What do you think of Silo season 3 so far? Feel free to let us know in the comments.

Apple TV's monthly subscription is $12.99, and discounts are available when bundled with Apple One.
